characters.identity_anchors: Small stuffed rabbit toy, fat and bunchy body; spotted brown-and-white velveteen coat; real thread whiskers; ears lined with pink sateen; boot-button eyes; back made all in one piece like a pincushion with no separate hind legs while a toy
characters.source_evidence: P18 fat and bunchy, spotted brown and white coat, real thread whiskers, ears lined with pink sateen; P36 boot-button eyes; P56 back made all in one piece like a pincushion, no hind legs; P37 fur getting shabbier, tail unsewn, pink rubbed off nose; P72 whiskers loved off, pink ear lining turned grey, brown spots faded, loses shape; P100 after Fairy: brown fur soft and shiny, hind legs, ears twitch by themselves, long whiskers
characters.voice_label: soft, shy, wondering child's toy voice that gains quiet confidence after becoming Real

wardrobe_variants.description: Brand-new splendid condition: plump firm stuffing, bright spotted brown-and-white velveteen pile fully intact, crisp pink sateen ear linings, neat thread whiskers, polished boot-button eyes, optional sprig of holly between paws

coat spotted brown and white

naturally shy
only made of velveteen
made to feel insignificant and commonplace

rolled over on him
pushed under the pillow
beautiful velveteen fur getting shabbier and shabbier
tail becoming unsewn
all the pink rubbed off his nose where the Boy had kissed him
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Soft bed-warmed look; faint crease marks from arms; nose dulled but still pinkish at first

wardrobe_variants.description: Noticeably loved-worn: fur thinner and earth-stained from garden burrows and dew, spots beginning to fade, ear linings dulling, shape still rabbit-like but softer and looser

whiskers loved off
pink lining to his ears turned grey
brown spots faded

wardrobe_variants.description: Extremely old and threadbare: coat thin and almost bald in hugged places, shapeless, whiskers gone, nose bare and shabby velvet, eyes dull; later cold and shivering in open sack among rubbish
source_facts: very old and shabby
coat had worn so thin and threadbare from hugging that it was no longer any protection
little shabby velvet nose
mass of scarlet fever germs
put into a sack with the old picture-books and a lot of rubbish
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Ashen dusty look under bedclothes then outdoor night chill; sack fabric framing head when he wriggles free; single real tear on nose

wardrobe_variants.description: Fully living wild rabbit: soft shiny brown fur all over, working hind legs and twitching ears, long whiskers that brush the grass; faint ghost of former spotted markings still visible under the fur; round black eyes and soft nose carrying a familiar look
source_facts: instead of dingy velveteen he had brown fur, soft and shiny
actually had hind legs
ears twitched by themselves
whiskers were so long that they brushed the grass
one of them was brown all over, but the other had strange markings under his fur, as though long ago he had been spotted
about his little soft nose and his round black eyes there was something familiar
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Natural rabbit musculature and movement; subtle residual spot patterning only visible in certain light for the reunion; joyful springing gait

characters.identity_anchors: Young child, kind-hearted little boy who talks to his toys, makes tunnels and burrows for the Rabbit, and fiercely defends that Bunny is Real; later flushed and feverish with scarlet fever then recovering and excited for the seaside
characters.source_evidence: P18 the Boy's stocking; P36 kind whispered games and tunnels like real rabbit burrows; P38 kind-hearted little boy; P42 You mustn't say that. He isn't a toy. He's REAL!; P73 face grew very flushed, talked in his sleep, little body so hot; P75 able to sit up and look at picture-books; P84 too excited about seaside to care much about new bunny; P103 playing in the wood in Spring
characters.voice_label: warm earnest child's voice, protective and imaginative, weaker and murmuring during fever

Boy's stocking

characters.identity_anchors: Very old stuffed toy horse; brown coat bald in patches showing seams underneath; most tail hairs pulled out; wise gentle expression; has already become Real long ago
characters.source_evidence: P21 the only person who was kind to him at all was the Skin Horse; P22 so old that his brown coat was bald in patches and showed the seams underneath, and most of the hairs in his tail had been pulled out to string bead necklaces; he was wise; P28 generally by the time you are Real most of your hair has been loved off... once you are Real you can't be ugly; P31 The Boy's Uncle made me Real... once you are Real you can't become unreal again
characters.voice_label: low, calm, kindly old voice full of quiet certainty and patience

wardrobe_variants.description: Threadbare brown skin-horse toy with bald patches, visible seams, sparse remaining tail hairs, soft worn leather or hide texture, gentle knowing eyes

characters.identity_anchors: Adult nursemaid who rules the nursery, tidies toys with sudden swoops, and is practical rather than sentimental about playthings
characters.source_evidence: P33 a person called Nana who ruled the nursery; sometimes... went swooping about like a great wind and hustled them away in cupboards; she called this tidying up; P34 Nana was in a hurry... made a swoop; P35 Here, she said, take your old Bunny!; P38 Nana had to come and look for him with the candle; P40 Fancy all that fuss for a toy!; P44 even Nana noticed... I declare if that old Bunny hasn't got quite a knowing expression!; P80 How about his old Bunny?
characters.voice_label: brisk practical adult woman's voice, occasionally grumbling, not unkind but no-nonsense

wardrobe_variants.description: Traditional early-20th-century nursemaid uniform: plain dark or grey dress, white apron, neat collar, practical hair; apron corner used to rub dew off Rabbit

tidying up
rubbed him off with a corner of her apron
came and look for him with the candle

wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Starched apron, sensible shoes, hair pinned up; candle in hand for night garden search; expression shifting from hurried to mildly exasperated to briefly surprised at Rabbit's look

characters.identity_anchors: Loveliest fairy; dress of pearl and dew-drops; flowers round her neck and in her hair; face like the most perfect flower; appears from a mysterious golden-cup blossom; can fly carrying the Rabbit
characters.source_evidence: P86 mysterious flower... slender green leaves the colour of emeralds, and in the centre of the leaves a blossom like a golden cup... out of it there stepped a fairy; P87 quite the loveliest fairy in the whole world. Her dress was of pearl and dew-drops, and there were flowers round her neck and in her hair, and her face was like the most perfect flower of all; P90 I am the nursery magic Fairy... I take care of all the playthings that the children have loved... turn them into Real; P94 flew with him into the wood
characters.voice_label: clear, gentle, luminous voice of quiet authority and kindness

wardrobe_variants.description: Iridescent dress appearing made of pearl and dew-drops; living flowers at neck and in hair; barefoot or light ethereal footwear; soft glow; holds and kisses the shabby Rabbit then carries him in flight

flowers round her neck and in her hair
face was like the most perfect flower of all
gathered him up in her arms and kissed him on his velveteen nose
held the little Rabbit close in her arms and flew with him
kissed the little Rabbit again and put him down on the grass
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Moonlit pearlescent fabrics with dew sparkle; no harsh glitter; warm compassionate expression; withheld from all beats before B12

characters.identity_anchors: Living wild rabbits, fully furry with no visible seams; bodies change shape when they move (long and thin then fat and bunchy); soft padding feet; twitching noses; long whiskers; able to hop on hind legs and dance; sharp eyes and keen sense of smell
characters.source_evidence: P47 two strange beings... rabbits like himself, but quite furry and brand-new... seams didn't show at all, and they changed shape in a queer way when they moved; one minute they were long and thin and the next minute fat and bunchy... feet padded softly... twitching their noses; P52 gave a big hop sideways and stood on his hind legs; P59 He hasn't got any hind legs!; P64 long whiskers brushed the Velveteen Rabbit's ear... wrinkled his nose suddenly... He doesn't smell right!; P95 the wild rabbits danced with their shadows on the velvet grass; P96 teach him all he needs to know in Rabbit-land
characters.voice_label: quick, bright, slightly teasing natural rabbit voices; later welcoming

characters.source_evidence: P74 Strange people came and went in the nursery; P77 the doctor's orders... room was to be disinfected, and all the books and toys that the Boy had played with in bed must be burnt; P81 That? said the doctor.
